stratagems.name: Devout Push
stratagems.target: One BLACK TEMPLARS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit. In addition, this turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Fell Back this turn.

stratagems.name: Crusader's Wrath
stratagems.target: One BLACK TEMPLARS unit from your army that made a charge move or was charged this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Never Retreat!
stratagems.target: One BLACK TEMPLARS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit cannot fail Morale tests and cannot be Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Suffer Not the Unclean to Live
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One BLACK TEMPLARS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack against a CHAOS or HERETIC unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
